case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that your CNC machines are ready and you want to get this job onto the shop floor. We want to give your shop steady work on the HX series, but several bidders are competing for this part, and the award goes to the best package, which we cannot promise in advance.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your machines a clear job at a price that reflects the following:

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On competition:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

On material cost:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

Your price is well above where this part needs to land, and these three points are why. We would like to find the right solution between two family-run companies, and Option A is our serious proposal for it.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Hallo, you did your homework with the material costs and the other offer, I respect that. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. We've tweaked the machines so the quality is solid now, let's get this running. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Our current offer is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that you need to clarify internally and will come back to us on price, and you welcomed faster payment. Option A is built for exactly that: it pays your shop sooner than your standard terms.

Several bidders are competing for the HX shaft, and the award goes to the best package, which we cannot promise in advance. Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives your machines a clear job and brings your cash in quickly.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 26.92; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.11; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

We appreciate your openness, and we want a fair solution for both family companies.

For whoever approves this on your side: Option A gives Zerspanung Dralveck a clear job on our new HX series and payment on short terms, so your invoices turn into cash quickly. It is a straightforward package that can be approved as it stands.

Could you please take Option A up internally and send us your answer?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a reliable, long-term partner. Option A below is built for that: it gives Strojírna Hrvelec the longest payment term of our three options, and the lead time is the same across all of them.

On quality:
Your quality was 980 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve, because the quality record and the movement in the alloy surcharge do not support your current offer, while Option A gives you a clear basis for planning with us on the HX series. Several bidders are competing for this award, and it goes to the best overall package.

For your management, in plain words: Option A offers a defined price, the most generous payment term of the three options and a fixed lead time, so the business can be planned with confidence. Please take Option A to your management as it stands.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
